description: This file defines assertion helper functions and macros for error reporting and program termination, including functions for formatted assertion messages and macros for various assertion checks.

methods.name: print_and_abort_1
methods.description: Formats and prints assertion failure message with file, line, function, and condition info, then aborts.

methods.name: print_and_abort_2
methods.description: Formats additional assertion message, prints it, and terminates the program.
